    elif i + 1 < length and input_list[i] == 'a' and input_list[i+1] == 't' and i != 0 and i != length - 2 and not found_at_symbol:
        output_str += '@'
        input_list[i] = ' '
        input_list[i+1] = ' '
        found_at_symbol = True
        i += 2
        continue
    # Append current character if not a space
    elif input_list[i] != ' ':
        output_str += input_list[i]
    i += 1

print(output_str)
